data.name: Basmah
data.gender_notes: Basmah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Basmah is an Arabic name that means 'smile' or 'to smile'. It is a name that symbolizes joy and happiness. The name Basmah carries the meaning “Smile” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Basmah usually hope their child will grow to embody smile and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, a smile is considered a form of charity, as it can bring happiness to others.
data.etymology: Basmah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Smile.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basmah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: بسمه
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من بسمة، وهي الابتسامة الخفيفة
in_arabic.long_meaning: بسمه اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة بسمة التي تعني الابتسامة الخفيفة. يرمز الاسم إلى الفرح والسرور، وقد وردت كلمة بسمة في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر آية 47، حيث يقول الله تعالى: 'وَلَا تَسۡأَلۡ مَنۡ أَحۡرَمۡ أَجۡلَهُ أَحَدًا'. وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية لما له من معنى جميل وروحاني.

in_urdu.name: بسمة
in_urdu.meaning: بسمة کا مطلب ہے ہلکی سی مسکراہٹ، خوشی کا اظہار
in_urdu.long_meaning: بسمة ایک عربی मूल کا اسم ہے، جو بسمة سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے ہلکی سی مسکراہٹ یا خوشی کا اظہار۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں فرح و مسرت کے جذبات سے وابستہ ہے۔ عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہونے کی وجہ سے، یہ نام اسلامی روایات میں گہرا معنی رکھتا ہے اور اسے خوبصورت سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बस्मा
in_hindi.meaning: बस्मा का अर्थ है हल्की सी मुस्कराहट, खुशी का इजहार
in_hindi.long_meaning: बस्मा एक अरबी मूल का नाम है, जो बस्मा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है हल्की सी मुस्कराहट या खुशी का इजहार। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में आनंद और सुख के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है। अरबी मूल से होने के कारण, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपराओं में गहरा महत्व रखता है और इसे सुंदर माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: بسمة
in_pashto.meaning: بسمة د خوښۍ څرګندونه، لږه موسکا
in_pashto.long_meaning: بسمة د عربي اصل يو نوم دی، چی د بسمة څخه اخيستل شوی دی، هغه د خوښۍ څرګندونه او يا لږه موسکا معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتني کلتور په منځ کې د خوښۍ او خوشحالي سره تړاو لري. د عربي ريښو له امله، دا نوم د پښتنو په اسلامي دودونو کې مهم دی.

in_english.name: Basmah
in_english.meaning: Smile, light laughter, expression of joy
in_english.long_meaning: Basmah is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the word 'basmah,' which means a light smile or laughter. It symbolizes joy, happiness, and warmth. In Islamic tradition, the name Basmah is associated with positive attributes and is considered a beautiful name. The root of the name is found in Arabic, where 'basmah' (بسمة) signifies a gentle smile. This name has been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting its universal appeal and significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Basmah is not widely used in the Islamic world but holds a significant cultural impact, particularly in the Middle East and North Africa. The name is associated with the beauty of a smile and the joy it brings to others. A person named Basmah is often seen as someone who radiates happiness and positivity.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Basmah holds deeper meanings rooted in Islamic teachings. A smile is considered a sign of Allah's mercy and love towards us. Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said, "The believer's shade on the Day of Resurrection will be his charity, and it will be welcoming for him because of the pleasure of Allah." (Muslim). Therefore, the act of smiling and spreading joy to others is a form of charity and an act of worship that brings us closer to Allah. Furthermore, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, although both are good." (Bukhari and Muslim). The name Basmah, with its association to joy and positivity, can serve as a reminder for us to strive towards being strong believers by spreading joy and happiness to others through our smiles.
